name: stagewatch-interop
description: The interop lane's driver: Stagewatch's rig, Patterns' bench host, PlayMap's node and AGMessage on a one-kernel LAN (lan.interop.cjs) and on one show laptop (laptop.interop.cjs), each topology in network namespaces of its own, at the commits tools/interop/siblings.json pins. Run through tools/test.sh interop, which builds them and makes the namespaces for each topology in turn.
